placements.title: Operationalizing first-week onboarding into a mandatory structured checklist over static wiki documentation
placements.frame: How does the organization structure and enforce first-week new hire onboarding across operational rotations and legacy documentation transitions?
placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 establish the mandatory first-week onboarding cadence (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) and its formal operational adoption replacing the previous wiki documentation.
